title: My profile
languageRestartBody: The app has to restart to change the reading direction.
deleteTitle: Ask us to delete my data
deleteIntro: You can ask us to delete everything we keep about you. The Ramassà team will do it and will get back to you.
deleteReasonLabel: Do you want to tell us why? (optional)
deleteReasonPlaceholder: Write it here if you want
deleteConfirmBody: This will send a request to the Ramassà team. They will review it and contact you. Your data will not be deleted now.
deletePendingTitle: You already have an open request
deletePendingBody: We received your request on {{date}}. The Ramassà team will be in touch.

saveFailed: We could not save your changes. Please try again.
saveBlocked: Something is missing. Check the highlighted fields above.
consentsIntro: You can change these whenever you want. The required ones are part of the authorization you signed.

appLockIntro: When the app lock is on, the AE Ramassà app asks for Face ID, your fingerprint or your phone's code when you come back to the app. This keeps your data safe if someone picks up your phone.
